title: GraniteAnalysisResponse
description: Strict schema for the raw JSON object returned by IBM Granite 3.0

rank.description: 1-based ranking of this clip by virality potential

start_time.description: Clip start offset in seconds from the beginning of the video

end_time.description: Clip end offset in seconds; must be > start_time

hook_text.description: Short attention-grabbing hook sentence for this clip

script_commentary.description: Detailed commentary explaining why this segment works as a short-form clip

virality_reasoning.description: One-paragraph reasoning for the assigned virality score
